rundown: 36ers beat United 101-93. 36ers led 59-35 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: 36ers won it 27-10.
Leading the way — United: Cole Anthony 27 pts; Joe Ingles 7 ast; Luke Travers 8 reb. 36ers: John Jenkins 21 pts; Bryce Cotton 10 ast; Zylan Cheatham 12 reb.
Where 36ers won it: they shot 48% to 47%, shot 42% from three to 25% and won the boards 38-29.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 12, 3:25 AM ET. It had United 56% and 36ers 44%, projecting United 92.7 – 36ers 90.9 (183.6 total, United by 1.8).

Final: United 93 – 36ers 101. Wrong winner: it had United at 56%, and 36ers (44%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
United came in with a league-average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (7-5, 98.4 scored and 90.9 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 24 and 24 games of evidence. Projected to score 92.7, they scored 93 (+0.3 points, 0% over); projected to allow 90.9, they allowed 101 (+10.1 points, 11% over).

36ers came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (6-6, 92.3 scored and 92.4 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 24 and 24 games of evidence. Projected to score 90.9, they scored 101 (+10.1 points, 11% over); projected to allow 92.7, they allowed 93 (+0.3 points, 0% over).

The bigger miss was 36ers' scoring (+10.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 194 against 183.6 projected (+10.4), about the 74th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: 36ers by 8 against United by 1.8 projected, about the 79th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.060 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +9.1 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 31 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.003 and gives home teams -0.6 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
